<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="375" height="667" viewBox="0 0 375 667">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="callGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".14"/>
    </filter>
    <clipPath id="avatarClip">
      <circle cx="187.5" cy="151" r="67"/>
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="667" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="18" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="318" y1="13" x2="322" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="318" y1="16" x2="324" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="318" y1="19" x2="326" y2="19" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="303" cy="16" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="299" y1="16" x2="307" y2="16" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="337" y="10" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <rect x="340" y="13" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="360" y="14" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="375" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points=" thirty 58, twenty 58" opacity="0"/>
  <polyline points="31,59 22,59 31,50" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="59" x2="38" y2="59" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="187.5" y="66" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Audio call</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="89" x2="375" y2="89" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- profile photo card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="105" width="327" height="244" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="187.5" cy="151" r="69" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#avatarClip)">
    <rect x="120" y="84" width="135" height="135" fill="#D0CECD"/>
    <circle cx="187" cy="139" r="25" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="187" cy="190" rx="49" ry="36" fill="#7D8490"/>
    <polygon points="132,202 169,164 184,179 207,153 250,202" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <circle cx="224" cy="111" r="11" fill="#EFC54D"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="237" cy="199" r="16" fill="#96E063" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="4"/>
  <polyline points="230,199 235,204 244,194" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="187.5" y="251" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Lina</text>
  <text x="187.5" y="278" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Available for an audio call</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="128" y="297" width="119" height="30" rx="15" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="317" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">$1.5 / minute</text>
  </g>

  <!-- confirmation section -->
  <text x="24" y="384" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="18" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Confirm your call</text>
  <text x="24" y="408" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You will be charged based on the duration of the call.</text>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="430" width="327" height="91" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <text x="45" y="457" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">YOUR ACCOUNT BALANCE</text>
  <text x="45" y="493" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="26" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">$1,500.00</text>
  <circle cx="321" cy="475" r="20" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <circle cx="321" cy="469" r="5" fill="#939393"/>
  <ellipse cx="321" cy="482" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#939393"/>

  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="544" width="327" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#callGradient)"/>
    <circle cx="143" cy="566" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="148" y1="571" x2="154" y2="577" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="201" y="571" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">START AUDIO CALL</text>
  </g>
  <text x="187.5" y="613" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Your balance will be updated after the call.</text>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="627" width="375" height="40" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="627" x2="375" y2="627" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="38,642 47,635 56,642 56,651 50,651 50,645 44,645 44,651 38,651" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="47" y="663" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="125" cy="641" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="120,641 124,645 131,637" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="125" y="663" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Matches</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="178" y="635" width="19" height="14" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="182,649 184,653 188,649" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="184" cy="642" r="1.2" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="190" cy="642" r="1.2" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="187.5" y="663" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="278" cy="640" r="5" fill="#939393"/>
    <ellipse cx="278" cy="649" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="278" y="663" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="336" cy="642" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="336" cy="642" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="630" x2="336" y2="634" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="650" x2="336" y2="654" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="336" y="663" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Settings</text>
  </g>
</svg>
